# secureaccess_zta_profile_internet_access_exceptions (Resource)

This resource manages a ZTA Profile Internet Access Exceptions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "secureaccess_zta_profile_internet_access_exceptions" "example" {
  zta_profile_id = "acde070d-8c4c-4f0d-9d8a-162843c10333"
  exceptions = [
    {
      destination = "*.example.com"
      description = "My exception"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `exceptions` (Attributes Set) List of destinations excluded from internet access for the ZTA Profile. System defined exceptions are not managed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--exceptions))
- `zta_profile_id` (String) ID of the ZTA Profile. Exceptions are relevant only when `internet_access_steering_mode` of the profile is `1` (all destinations).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `revision` (Number) Revision of the configuration.

<a id="nestedatt--exceptions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `exceptions`

Required:

- `destination` (String) Destination to exclude. FQDN, wildcard FQDN, IPv4 address and CIDR are allowed.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Description of the exception and why it exists.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import secureaccess_zta_profile_internet_access_exceptions.example "<zta_profile_id>"
```
